contract: These are abstract transferable language tasks. Sample names, objects, rooms, and circumstances are interchangeable data, NOT characters, plot, world canon, or quests.
All 13 LO items are specified without an assumed ship, technology, occupation, story day, or NPC biography.
A/B variants change only a critical meaning, not a story beat; counterfactuals are authorship checks, not executable tests.
R meaning must come from German Input rather than Russian UI or visual guessing; W means free German Output without a provided complete answer.
Accept semantic equivalents and clarification; grammar or spelling differences are nonblocking when the intended meaning is unambiguous.
These examples illustrate outcomes, do not determine required vocabulary independently of LANGUAGE_LEXICON.md.

items.blocker: M08/Sie not yet supported in mandatory source
source_a: An Anna: Komm bitte um zehn.
An Herrn Weber: Kommen Sie bitte um zwölf.
source_b: An Anna: Komm bitte um zwölf.
An Herrn Weber: Kommen Sie bitte um zehn.
items.counterfactual: Change the time in the German message, keeping addressee and register constant.
items.wrong: Assign the formal Sie request to Anna or swap the hours.

items.counterfactual: Swap prohibition and non-obligation in the same visual layout.
items.wrong: Treat a prohibition as optionality, or vice versa.

source_a: Bring das Buch in die Küche.
source_b: Das Buch ist in der Küche.
items.counterfactual: Swap the German source/destination with both rooms visually plausible.
items.wrong: Confuse where the item is with where to bring it.

items.counterfactual: Change German calendar entries without auto-highlighting the right answer.
items.wrong: Select an occupied appointment slot or wrong day.

items.blocker: Need meaningful complete message practice in mandatory input
source_a: Hallo! Ich bin heute krank. Komm bitte morgen um zehn. Danke! Mia.
source_b: Hallo! Ich bin heute krank. Komm bitte morgen um zwölf. Danke! Mia.
items.counterfactual: Change only the requested hour; the named sender is an arbitrary placeholder.
items.wrong: Confuse today/tomorrow or report the wrong appointment time.

items.counterfactual: Reverse the states while retaining the same two dates and format.
items.wrong: Take an old note as a current fact.

items.goal_ru: В знакомой бытовой ситуации попросить конкретный предмет или узнать, где он находится; готовой немецкой реплики нет.
items.counterfactual: Change the required object while preserving interaction and affordances.
items.wrong: Request a cup when a book is needed.

items.goal_ru: Самостоятельно сообщить другому человеку наблюдаемый факт о знакомом предмете и его состоянии; факт ему неизвестен.
items.counterfactual: Change the observed state only; the listener cannot see the object.
items.wrong: Say full when the cup is empty.

items.goal_ru: Согласовать время и передать разницу между запретом и отсутствием обязанности.
acceptable_examples: Um zehn. Hier darf ich nicht arbeiten.
items.counterfactual: Change time and modality independently across two variants; evaluate both meaning dimensions.
items.wrong: Confuse nicht dürfen with nicht müssen or give the wrong time.

items.goal_ru: Ответить на предложение двух знакомых напитков, сообщив собственное предпочтение, заданное условиями варианта.
items.counterfactual: Change only the character's preference, not the offered choices.

items.goal_ru: Сообщить человеку, который не видел действие, о найденном предмете и о том, когда это произошло.
acceptable_examples: Ich habe gestern das Buch gefunden.
items.counterfactual: Change only the found item, preserving the time and recipient information gap.
items.wrong: Attribute the find to another person or name the wrong object.

items.goal_ru: По знакомым немецким подписям самостоятельно заполнить простую форму из независимых известных данных.
acceptable_examples: Name: Anna; Tag: Montag; Zeit: zehn Uhr.
items.counterfactual: Change the values while retaining field labels; names are arbitrary sample data, not NPC canon.
items.wrong: Swap values between fields or copy the other variant.

items.goal_ru: Передать другому человеку несколько независимых новых сведений о предмете, его местонахождении и просьбе о времени.
acceptable_examples: Das Buch ist im Zimmer. Komm bitte morgen um zehn.
Buch im Zimmer. Morgen um zehn, bitte.
items.counterfactual: Change just one meaning-bearing fact at a time: object/place or appointment hour.
items.wrong: Omit a critical item, reverse place and destination, or change the time.
